title: ranunculus micranthus var. delitescens
intro: Ranunculus micranthus var. delitescens, commonly known as the small-flowered ranunculus, is a plant species in the buttercup family that is native to Western Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in Western Australia for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus micranthus var. delitescens include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
